furniture_a.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent furniture turnarounds for EXISTING Trætoppen. Image 1 interior_domestic.png and image 2 interior_regal.png are the AUTHORITATIVE painted material/line references. Match their matte gouache/watercolor, uneven warm grey-brown pencil edges, worn honey timber, cream, sage and little brass details. Preserve broad practical furniture silhouettes, no glossy 3D, plastic, vector cubes or photorealistic furniture. Neutral daytime albedo, no baked glow, no floor shadows, no floor base, no ground rectangle, no text or labels. TRUE alpha transparency. One substantial complete connected object per cell with generous clear gutters.
Create ONE STRICT 4 COLUMN by 4 ROW sprite atlas: four furniture types, ONE TYPE PER ROW; the SAME physical object is rotated in the four columns. Fixed orthographic elevated camera, 36 degrees; verticals upright; no perspective convergence. COLUMN 1 r0: FRONT face points toward bottom-left, right side visible. COLUMN 2 r1: FRONT face points bottom-right, left side visible. COLUMN 3 r2: BACK face points bottom-left, opposite rear corner, hide front handles/keys/cushion front where occluded. COLUMN 4 r3: BACK face points bottom-right, other rear corner. These are four actual object rotations, not four unrelated designs or four repeated front views. Cabinet backs must show plain joined timber backs. Chair backs must conceal most of the seat. All legs complete, same scale in all columns. Keep the normal small asymmetric grain/cloth details consistent around the object.
ROW 1: a broad practical pine double bed with two cream pillows, low plank footboard, medium arched timber headboard, muted sage quilt stitched in large patches; no posts above the headboard. In front views the foot is nearer; in REAR views the tall headboard is nearer and hides the pillows. ROW 2: a simple rectangular empty honey oak dining table, broad plank top with slight wear and four stout rounded legs; no crockery. ROW 3: a small cottage wood chair with three back slats and a sage cushion tied to the seat; no other objects. ROW 4: a comfortable two-seat sage cloth sofa with honey wood feet and one cream pillow, curved arms and subtle seams; REAR views show its complete upholstered back, no frontal seat opening. No canopy, giant ornament, flowers or characters.
